text: Solomon selects Bael: He maketh thee to go Invisible.
Solomon selects Stolas: He teacheth the Art of Astronomy, and the Virtues of Herbs and Precious Stones.
Solomon selects Marbas: He is a Great President, and appeareth at first in the form of a Great Lion, but afterwards, at the request of the Master, he putteth on Human Shape.
Solomon selects Ronove: He teacheth the Art of Rhetoric very well and giveth Good Servants, Knowledge of Tongues, and Favours with Friends or Foes.

Solomon selects Murmur: and appeareth in the Form of a Warrior riding upon a Gryphon, with a Ducal Crown upon his Head.
